title: Vice President - Software Engineering
description:
**Job Summary**

The Vice President - Software Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, and continuous evolution of the MADTECH.AI platform. This role provides strategic and technical leadership to multiple engineering teams responsible for building scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS products.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in software architecture, cloud platforms, AI-enabled applications, data engineering, DevOps, and modern engineering practices. This individual will build high-performing engineering teams, establish engineering excellence, drive innovation, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products while working closely with Product Management, AI/ML, Data Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Business leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Engineering Strategy & Technology Leadership**

* Define and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the organization's business and product objectives.
* Establish engineering standards, architectural principles, coding best practices, and software development governance.
* Drive technology modernization and adoption of emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, cloud-native platforms, and automation.
* Develop long-term technology roadmaps to ensure scalability, maintainability, and security.

**Software Engineering Leadership**

* Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for backend, frontend, platform engineering, integrations, and DevOps.
* Ensure successful delivery of high-quality software products within timelines and budget.
* Oversee software architecture, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Drive engineering productivity through Agile delivery methodologies and engineering metrics.

**Architecture & Platform Engineering**

* Provide technical leadership for scalable microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Guide architectural decisions across cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, AI services, and integrations.
* Ensure platform scalability, performance, availability, reliability, and security.
* Lead architecture reviews and technology evaluations.

**Engineering Operations & Delivery Excellence**

* Improve engineering processes, SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and deployment automation.
* Implement DevSecOps best practices.
* Monitor engineering KPIs including
* Velocity
* Quality
* Reliability
* Deployment frequency
* MTTR
* Engineering efficiency
* Ensure operational excellence through observability, monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis.

**AI & Data Engineering Enablement**

* Collaborate with AI/ML teams to integrate intelligent capabilities into the platform.
* Enable scalable data pipelines, APIs, AI agents, RAG architectures, and GenAI applications.
* Promote engineering practices that support analytics, automation, and customer intelligence.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Product Management to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Collaborate with QA, Security, DevOps, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Support customer escalations requiring engineering leadership.

**People Leadership**

* Recruit, mentor, coach, and retain world-class engineering talent.
* Build a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Develop engineering managers and technical leads.
* Drive performance management, succession planning, and career development.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong expertise in designing and developing scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS applications using modern software engineering principles and best practices.
* Deep understanding of software architecture, including microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API-first design, and multi-tenant platforms.
* Proficiency in cloud platforms, with hands-on experience in AWS (mandatory); exposure to Azure and GCP is preferred. Strong knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Extensive experience with modern software development technologies and frameworks such as Java, Python, Node.js, React, Angular, TypeScript, and related technologies.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including AI Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architectures, MCP (Model Context Protocol), TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and LLM integrations.
* Experience with data engineering, including SQL, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, reverse ETL, data modeling, data lakes, and large-scale data processing frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, event-driven architectures, Kafka, webhooks, third-party integrations, and modern integration frameworks.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), automated testing, release management, monitoring, logging, observability, and production support.
* Expertise in Agile software development methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, Jira, engineering planning, sprint execution, and continuous delivery.
* Strong understanding of software quality engineering, secure coding practices, performance optimization, scalability, reliability engineering, and engineering governance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Master's degree preferred.
* 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 8 years leading large engineering teams.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale B2B SaaS products.
* Strong hands-on background in software architecture, cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, and modern application development.
* Experience leading engineering organizations of 30+ engineers across multiple functional teams.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies, cloud-native applications, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience working with global customers across the US, UK, Australia, and MENA markets.
* Demonstrated success in building high-performing engineering organizations.
* Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.
* Willing to work from Mysuru or Bengaluru.

**Why MADTECH.AI?**

Join us in building the future of AI-powered Marketing Decision Intelligence.

At MADTECH.AI, we're developing a next-generation B2B SaaS platform that brings together AI, advanced analytics, cloud technologies, and intelligent automation to help organizations make faster, smarter, and data-driven business decisions.

As the VP – Software Engineering, you will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision of our platform, lead high-performing engineering teams, and influence the architecture of products used by global customers. You'll work on cutting-edge technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence.

If you're passionate about building scalable SaaS products, mentoring exceptional engineering talent, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-growing AI company, MADTECH.AI offers the opportunity to innovate, lead, and grow with us.

**Job Title**
-------------

Senior Network Software Engineering Specialist

**Job Summary**

Provide and lead specialist analysis, design, development and deployment in network specific technology domains, including developing platform specific technology roadmaps and making technology investment recommendations to deliver products and infrastructure to defined service level standards

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Who We Are**

Telstra is Australia’s leading telecommunications and technology company spanning over a century with a footprint in over 20+ countries. In India, we’re building a platform for innovative delivery and engagement that will strengthen our position as an industry leader. We’ve grown quickly since our inception in 2019, now with offices in Pune and Bangalore  

  

Focus of the role:

  

The Senior Solution Designer / Lead Software Engineer will provide architecture, technical design, and hands-on engineering leadership for the TNI mission. The role requires deep telecommunications OSS and physical network inventory expertise, strong knowledge of the Inventory Platform, and proven capability in designing scalable, resilient, graph-based enterprise solutions. The successful candidate will translate complex business requirements into pragmatic technical designs, implementation roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes while building effective relationships with stakeholders at all organisational levels.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture and technical design for TNI capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, security, resilience, and delivery standards.
* Design high-performance Neo4j graph solutions covering graph data models, schemas, relationships, indexing, query optimisation, versioning, migration, and operational performance.
* Translate complex business and platform requirements into scalable solution designs, implementation roadmaps, integration patterns, and delivery plans.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and modern enterprise application frameworks.
* Design and deliver enterprise APIs and integrations using OData, REST, and GraphQL.
* Apply deep Inventory Platform knowledge to solution decisions involving business processes, architecture, APIs, and the underlying data model.
* Drive application modernisation, platform resilience, automation, and adoption of AI-enabled and emerging technology solutions.
* Perform business analysis and gap assessments, recommending system and process improvements that increase efficiency and deliver business benefits.
* Collaborate with business, architecture, engineering, data, operations, and delivery stakeholders to manage dependencies, risks, and design decisions.
Provide technical governance, design assurance, documentation, and mentoring throughout the solution lifecycle.  

  

**Mandatory Requirements**
==========================

* Significant experience in software design and delivery, including demonstrated experience in solution architecture, technical design, and enterprise application development.
* Strong practical experience with Neo4j graph database technologies, including graph data modelling, performance optimisation, and enterprise-scale implementation.
* Extensive capability in Neo4j solution design and graph data architecture, including graph modelling, schema design, query optimisation, indexing strategies, relationship modelling, versioning approaches, data migration, and high-performance graph solution implementation.
* Strong knowledge of telecommunications inventory platforms or comparable network inventory environments, including business processes, architecture, APIs, and underlying data models.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering API and integration solutions using OData, REST, and GraphQL.
* Hands-on software development experience with Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and modern enterprise application frameworks.
* Experience delivering AI-enabled solutions, driving automation initiatives, and adopting emerging technologies in enterprise environments.
Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions, architecture designs, and implementation roadmaps.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, and telecommunications OSS or network inventory environments. They will be skilled in requirements analysis, gap assessment, enterprise application design, legacy modernisation, and platform resilience. The role also requires strong stakeholder engagement, sound technical judgement, and the ability to influence architecture and delivery outcomes across multidisciplinary teams.

  
  

**Core Skills and Tools**
=========================

* Telecommunications OSS and physical network inventory
* Master data management
* Solution architecture
* Enterprise architecture and governance
* Enterprise application integration
* Business analysis and business process management
* Order and alarm management
* SOA, SCA, ESB, and microservices architecture
* Agile Scrum delivery
* Platform resilience and application modernisation
* Microsoft technologies, open-source technologies, and low-code/no-code platforms
* Oracle, including PL/SQL and Pro\*C; Neo4j
* Microsoft Azure cloud solutions
* Confluence and Jira

**Desirable Certifications and Training**
=========================================

* A relevant tertiary qualification in computer science, software engineering, information technology, telecommunications, or a related discipline is desirable.
* Industry-recognised architecture certification, such as TOGAF, is desirable.
* Training or certification in telecommunications frameworks, enterprise architecture, design thinking, cloud platforms, data engineering, or business analysis will be advantageous.

**Relevant Domain Experience**
==============================

* Experience designing or delivering telecommunications OSS solutions across order fulfilment, assurance, service activation, and physical or logical network inventory domains.
* Experience with enterprise-scale inventory transformation, data migration, or platform modernisation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of network and service inventory data, relationships, lifecycle management, and integration with upstream and downstream systems.
* Experience designing resilient solutions for complex legacy and modern application landscapes.
* Practical experience with relational and graph data technologies, including Oracle and Neo4j.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, microservices, API-led integration, DevSecOps practices, and agile delivery environments.
Ability to work effectively with product, business, architecture, engineering, data, operations, and vendor teams in a large enterprise environment.

description:

Digital Solution Engineering Manager \#\#\#

Working as a Global Digital Portfolio Cyber Security Expert, you will play a critical role in safeguarding our organization's digital assets for products of the global AUEN Digital Energy Management / Autonomous Operations products.



You will be responsible for **defining, governing and assuring cybersecurity\-by\-design across global R\&D product development**, ensuring compliance with ABB Product Security requirements, international standards (e.g. IEC 62443\), and applicable regulations.



The role acts as **global cybersecurity reference for the Digital Energy Management and Autonomous Operations product portfolio**, working with R\&D teams to embed security requirements into architectures, software, and lifecycle processes (SPDLC), while **challenging designs and approving security readiness**.



In this role, you will be part of a global team of product owners, software developers, architects, and testers to apply principles of software engineering, contribute to development as part of different state\-of\-the\-art cloud and edge software systems and architectures of the product portfolio.



You will be hosted in one of the team locations: Mannheim (DE), Genoa (IT), Bangalore (IN) in a hybrid mode (\#LI\-Hybrid)



Relocation of the candidate is not required.**\***



Your work will have a profound impact on the global cloud, cloud\-native and edge platform landscape.



You will be mainly accountable for:

Develop and implement comprehensive cyber security strategies, policies, and procedures to protect digital on\-prem/edge/cloud products against cyber threats, including malware, phishing, data breaches, and insider threats following the minimum cyber\-security requirements from ABB in full compliance, and responsibility, with PSA (Product Security Assessment) internal process.

Implement access controls, encryption, and other security measures to safeguard sensitive data in line with Global Digital Team direction.

* Master's degree in computer science with a focus on IT security. A PhD with cyber security focus is considered a plus.

*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*

*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*

*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*

**Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**

You will drive solution design, architecture decisions, and technical direction, while ensuring delivery excellence. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, architecture, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver robust, secure, and reliable solutions aligned with business goals.  

  

This role reports to a Project Manager / Senior Manager.

* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications
* Own solution architecture for modules/domains, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability
* Drive modernization initiatives (monolith to microservices, cloud adoption)
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Review architecture, code, and design to ensure quality and maintainability
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering strong technical capability within teams
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns

**Experience**

* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies

**Tech Stack**

* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube

**Additional Information**

**Required Qualifications:**  

Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent  

  

**Personal Skills:**

* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.


Additional Information

**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**

* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* + 24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more

**The Location:**


Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.

**Why Should You Apply?**

* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.

**Start date: ASAP**


Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview

 **Qualifications**  

* MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

Cigna is a global health insurance company, dedicated to its mission of helping improve the health, well\-being, and peace of mind of those we serve by making health care simple, affordable, and predictable.


Together with colleagues located across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, and India, you will support Cigna's International Health business. We are going through a global Agile transformation. As a result, we are expanding our teams and are looking for experienced Scrum Masters / Agile Team Coaches to join our team.

**Purpose of the Role**
=======================


The purpose of the Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach role is to maximize value delivery through collaboration, impediment removal, visibility, learning, and evidence\-based improvement.


This role supports high\-performing team dynamics, sustainable delivery, continuous flow, and self\-managed teams that are shaping and maturing Agile ways of working across International Health.

==================


The Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach is a team coach and servant leader who facilitates change through the adoption and application of Agile principles, practices, and frameworks.


The role enables teams to self\-organize, improve flow, embrace effective ways of working, and consistently deliver value outcomes to stakeholders. The role partners closely with Product Owners, team members, Release Train Engineers, Agile Product Managers, and other stakeholders to support predictable delivery and continuous improvement.
